advisor_identified: John W. Hellman, professor of European intellectual and modern French history at McGill University.

doctorate.title: Emmanuel Mounier and Esprit: Personalist Dialogue with Existentialism, Marxism and Christianity

evidence.says: McGill identifies John W. Hellman as a professor specializing in European intellectual and modern French history and lists his degree as PhD (Harvard).

The acknowledgements of The Grands Magasins Dufayel, the Working Class, and the Origins of Consumer Culture in Paris, 1880-1916 identify John Hellman as the thesis supervisor, confirming the advisor connection in the entry.

Marie-Paule Lebel, Mounier ou l’audace d’une civilisation nouvelle (1987), bibliography, printed p. 293, lists John Hellman’s Emmanuel Mounier and Esprit: Personalist Dialogue with Existentialism, Marxism and Christianity as a history doctoral thesis at Harvard University, 1969.

notes: The linked record matches the independently corroborated institution, year and title.
